name: A shared rhythm / a living technical diagram
art: Use coherent native vector geometry and one shared logical clock. The original artwork and demonstration copy are in the cited implementation.

properties.label: Editorial explanation beside fanout drawing
properties.text: Balance a left editorial explanation with a large light drawing sheet. One small dimensional lead object dispatches to four distinct process specimens through curved routes, then resolves into a merged result and one progress strip.

properties.label: Coherent routed process specimens
properties.text: Use real curved vector routes, small colored packets, consistent projection, different internal specimen drawings and readable status. Avoid generic connected icons.

properties.label: Warm paper with restrained signals
properties.text: Use warm paper, precise green-gray lines, pale modeled node faces, small specimen labels and a restrained family of signal colors.

properties.label: One clock for dispatch, work and return
properties.text: Coordinate dispatch, work and return with one six-second logical clock. Move packets on actual SVG route geometry and update status only at semantic stages. Watch and Stop are explicit, the completed frame stays useful, and reduced motion presents completion immediately.

properties.label: Illustrative process, not agent telemetry
properties.text: The sequence illustrates a process. Do not claim actual agent work or numerical productivity results.

properties.label: Diagram state consistency
properties.text: Packet positions, selected nodes, captions and progress must agree. Test stopping, replay, navigation cleanup and hidden tabs.
